data.boost_ac_heat_assist: Allow air conditioner heat assist in boost
data.name: Room name

data_description.ac_entity_id: Optional climate entity used for supported cooling, dry, fan-only, and heat-assist modes.
data_description.enable_safe_cooling_delay: When enabled, enforce both minimum cooling on and off times for compressor-driven cooling and dry operation.
data_description.minimum_seconds_cooling_on: Seconds cooling must remain active before automatic temperature control may stop it. Explicit off and safety interlocks still stop outputs immediately.
data_description.minimum_seconds_cooling_off: Seconds the compressor must remain inactive before a cooling or dry request may start it. AC off and fan-only both count as inactive.
data_description.boost_ac_heat_assist: When enabled, the boost preset may request AC heating alongside the primary room heater. Enable only after verifying the equipment supports heating.
data_description.cooling_hysteresis_off: While cooling, stop after temperature falls below the target by this offset.
data_description.cooling_hysteresis_on: Start cooling when temperature reaches the target plus this offset.
data_description.heater_entity_id: Optional heating climate entity, TRV, or switch. Verify the actuator can be turned off and is ready before relying on shared heat demand.
data_description.heating_hysteresis_off: While heating, stop after temperature reaches the target plus this offset.
data_description.heating_hysteresis_on: Start heating when temperature reaches the target minus this offset.
data_description.mode_reversal_guard_seconds: Seconds that must pass before changing between heating and cooling paths.
data_description.name: A display name for this room subentry.
data_description.rapid_entity_id: Optional switch enabled by the boost preset while an HVAC path is active.
data_description.silent_entity_id: Optional switch enabled by the sleep preset while an HVAC path is active.
data_description.temperature_sensor_entity_ids: One or more temperature entities. Valid fresh readings are converted to Celsius and averaged.
data_description.temperature_sensor_max_age_seconds: Maximum reading age in seconds, from 1 to 604800. The default is 300 seconds.
data_description.trv_target_offset: Degrees added to the virtual target sent to a heating climate entity or TRV.
data_description.window_entity_ids: Optional one or more binary sensors. Any open sensor suppresses room outputs. If none is open, any unknown, unavailable, missing, or unexpected state also suppresses outputs.

reconfigure.description: Update one room. Use outputs dedicated to this controller and remove competing writers before arming it. Confirm TRV readiness and provide a hydraulic bypass or equivalent safe flow path where the heating system requires one.
reconfigure.title: Reconfigure room
